description: This file defines the EmployeePersonalDetailController class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin's Controller namespace. It manages the pre-render logic for employee personal details, including loading nationality data, configuring UI components, and setting permissions based on the request data.

classes.name: EmployeePersonalDetailController
classes.description: Controller class handling the display and configuration of employee personal details within the OrangeHRM system, including permission checks and dynamic UI component setup.

methods.name: getNationalityService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of the NationalityService.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the data and UI components for rendering employee personal details, setting props, loading nationalities, and permissions.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups used for capability permission checks, specifically for personal information.
